newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli troops feared dead in helicopter collision.
newsitem.headline: Israeli troops feared dead in helicopter collision.

text.p: Several Israeli soldiers were feared killed in a collision on Tuesday between two military helicopters in stormy weather near the border with Lebanon, Israel Radio said.
The helicopters collided over northern Israel and wreckage landed inside a farming community, witnesses said.
The army said the helicopters collided over northern Israel and an announcement would be made later on Tuesday. No further details were immediately available.
